subject.title: Discord account-to-agent routing falls back to default agent instead of matching by account name

question: Should Discord multi-account routing add a guarded same-name accountId-to-agent fallback when no explicit binding matches, or should explicit bindings remain the only supported contract?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but changing fallback behavior affects security, session state, provider/model routing, and compatibility with the documented explicit-binding contract.

options.title: Approve guarded fallback
options.body: Route non-default Discord account IDs to an existing same-named configured agent only after explicit binding tiers miss, with clear diagnostics, docs, tests, and live proof.

options.title: Keep explicit bindings only
options.body: Leave runtime routing unchanged and add clearer docs, doctor, or status warnings for Discord accounts that appear intended to bind to same-named agents.

options.title: Repair the fork PR first
options.body: Use the open fork PR as source material after resolving conflicts, adding a configured-agent guard and distinct matchedBy value, and supplying real Discord proof.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded fallback
recommendation.body: Route non-default Discord account IDs to an existing same-named configured agent only after explicit binding tiers miss, with clear diagnostics, docs, tests, and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal on shared routing behavior and prior review routing for this issue.
